        if (costSoFar < minCost) minCost = costSoFar;
        return;

}

    long long inputNum;

    powers[0] = 1LL;

    for (int k = 1; k <= 18; ++k) powers[k] += powers[k-1];
    
    maxPos = 0;
    while (maxPos < 18 && powers[maxPos+1] <= inputNum) maxPos++;
    
    traverse(maxPos, inputNum, 0);
